div.l: And shorte and quik of hie sentence
And that was seid in forme of reuerence
Sownyng in morall vertue was his speche
And gladli lerne and gladli teche
A Sergeaunt of lawe ware and wise
That oft had ben at ꝑparuys
That was also ful riche of excellence
Discrete he was and of grete reuerence
Him semed siche . his wordez were so wise
Iustice he was full oft in Assise
Be patent and be playne cōmmissioıı̄un
For his sciens and his hie renoun̄
Of fees and robes had many one
So grete a purchasoure was no wher none
All was fe simple to him in effecte
His purchasing might be to him in suspecte
No where so besi a man as he þer nas
And yit him semed besier þan he was
In termes had he cases and domes all
That sith þe tyme of king william wer fall
Thereto he couth endite and make a thing
Ther couth no wight pinche at his writing
And eueri statute he couth plaine be rote
He rode homeli in a medle cote
I girded with a seint of silk with barres smale
Of his Aray tel I no lenger tale
A Frankeleyn was in oure company
Whight was his berde as a daisy
Of his complexioıı̄un he was sanguyn̄
Wel loued he bi þe morow a soppe in wyn̄
For he was Eupiours owne son̄
To lyue in delite was euer his won̄
That held opinioıı̄un that plaine delite
Was vereli Felicite and ꝑparfite
An hous holder and þat a grete was he
Seint Iulian he was called in his contre
His brede his Ale was alwey aftre oone
A better wifed man was þere none
With oute baken mete was neuer his
Both fissh and flessh and þat so plentous
It snewed in his house of mete and drink
Of al deintees that men couth thenke
Aftre þe sondri sesons of þe yere
So changed he his mete and his souper
